description: Sets what is on each stem from what the person says about their files (stem ids and file names come from get_song_status). It does not confirm the labels: the person still confirms them with "Labels are correct" in the studio before anything is mixed.

label.description: What is on the stem. kick = kick drum; snare = snare drum; hihat = hi-hat; toms = toms; overheads = drum overheads (cymbals and the whole kit from above); room_mics = drum room mics; drum_bus = all drums on one track (drum mix or drum loop); percussion = percussion (shaker, congas, claps, tambourine); bass_electric = electric bass guitar; bass_acoustic = upright or acoustic bass; bass_synth = synth bass or 808; guitar_electric_clean = clean electric guitar; guitar_electric_distorted = distorted or overdriven electric guitar; guitar_acoustic = acoustic guitar (steel strings); guitar_nylon = nylon-string or classical guitar; piano = piano; organ = organ; synth_pad = synth pad; synth_lead = synth lead; keys_other = other keys (Rhodes, e-piano, keyboard); vocal_lead = lead vocal (the main sung vocal); vocal_backing = backing vocals, harmonies or ad-libs; vocal_rap = rap vocal; strings = strings (violin, cello, string section); brass = brass (trumpet, trombone, horns); woodwinds = woodwinds (flute, sax, clarinet); instrumental = full instrumental or beat (everything but the vocals on one stereo track); ambient = ambience, effects, textures or noise; other = something else, or not sure.

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.
